title: Device setup
copyNote: Closing this window empties the clipboard, whatever it holds by then, so something you copied from another app after this value is lost too. The value carries your access, so paste it before you close. If the browser refuses at that moment, the clipboard is emptied when you come back to this tab. The clipboard history that Windows and some other systems keep is out of our reach: clear it yourself.

unavailable.title: Setup is not ready yet
unavailable.text: The administrator has to set the domain and the DNS addresses. After that this section works by itself.

share.title: Endpoint setup
share.notFoundText: The link has expired, was revoked, has run out of uses or was not typed correctly. Ask whoever sent it to make a new one.
share.languageUse: Changing the language opens the page again and uses one of this link's uses.
share.notReadyText: The service is not ready for this Endpoint yet. Try again in a little while, or ask whoever sent the link. This visit did not use up one of the link's uses.

legacy.title: Plain DNS (not encrypted)
legacy.hint: For devices that only take a DNS address. It only works from a network whose address you have claimed.
legacy.off: Plain DNS is off for this Endpoint. These addresses will not answer until you turn it on in the Endpoint's edit dialog.

secure.title: Secure DNS (encrypted)
secure.hint: For browsers, phones and apps that take encrypted DNS. DNS 1 always comes first.

rows.doh3Hint: The same URL as DoH, opened over HTTP/3. It has no stamp of its own.

stamps.title: DNS Stamps
stamps.guide: If your app takes one stamp, use the first one. If it takes a list, add both address stamps.
stamps.several: For apps that take several stamps

wizard.title: Setup guide
wizard.shareClaim: Plain DNS only works for a network whose address the Endpoint’s owner has claimed. If it does not work, ask the owner to check that.

verify.title: Setup check
verify.hint: After you set it up, check that this device uses this Endpoint.

states.pending: Waiting for a query from this device…
states.partial: A query arrived, but not through this Endpoint. Check the device's setup again.
states.timeout: Nothing was seen for two minutes. Check the setup and try again.
states.success: The setup is right and the device uses this Endpoint.

verify.otherClient: The query came from another client of this Endpoint.
verify.manualHint: The automatic check is not on in this installation, or the service uses a private certificate authority that a browser does not trust. Run one of these commands on the device. It asks over Plain DNS, so it does not test an encrypted setup.
verify.manualResult: If you get an address, some Endpoint of this service holds this network’s claim, and it may not be this one. A refusal means no Endpoint holds it. An empty answer means the check cannot tell.
verify.manualNoClaims: This Endpoint holds no network that identifies devices now, so an address in the answer belongs to another Endpoint.
verify.manualCompare: If the answer is inside one of these networks, the device uses this Endpoint.

freeDns.on: The query reached our service, but this network is not added to the Endpoint. If the device uses our Plain DNS addresses, it gets free DNS without your filters.
freeDns.off: The query reached our service, but this network is not added to the Endpoint. If the device uses our Plain DNS addresses, its queries are refused.

apple.ssidsHint: The DNS profile is not used on these networks. Up to 50 names.
apple.domainsHint: These domains go through the device's normal DNS. Up to 100 domains.
apple.folderHint: The folder's domains are added to the list above.
apple.commonHint: A list of widely used domains that should not go through the filter.
apple.prohibitHint: Only works on supervised Apple devices.

problems.full: You have reached the limit of {max}.

apple.unsignedText: When you install it, the Apple device says the profile is not verified. That is expected and has nothing to do with how safe the DNS is.
apple.qrTitle: QR code to download the profile
apple.qrHint: Scan it with the camera of the Apple device.
apple.staleText: The endpoint ID or the DNS addresses changed after you downloaded the profile. Build a new profile and install it again.

link.intro: You create a link that shows the setup guide of this Endpoint with no sign-in. It stops working when the ID is rotated or the link is revoked.
link.qrTitle: QR code of the setup link
link.once: This link is shown only this once. After you close the dialog it cannot be seen again.
link.revokeAria: Revoke the setup link of {name}, valid until {when}

leave.title: Leave and lose the link?
leave.text: The link on this screen is shown only once. If you leave now you cannot see it again, and it stays active until it ends or you revoke it.
